source_instruction: i'm looking for a wide leg jeans with regular fit and tummy control. also, choose 3x large zz-zm black colored one.
query: I took my rescue pit bull Mabel to the local community dog park earlier today, and the whole afternoon felt like such a perfect little surprise. The weather was that soft, warm early fall kind where the sun doesn’t burn too hot, and a light breeze carries the smell of the apple cider donut stand set up right at the park entrance. Mabel made fast friends with a tiny, fluffy Pomeranian who kept stealing her favorite frayed rope toy, and a group of regulars brought homemade peanut butter pumpkin treats to pass out to every pup that wandered over. By the time we headed home, Mabel was passed out in the backseat covered in grass stains and crumbs, and I was already looking forward to going back next weekend. I’ve heard that women’s jeans that are relaxed fit, have tummy control, and a wide leg work really well for casual, comfortable everyday wear, and I’ve heard the zz-zmblack color and 3X-Large size are options that exist for that exact style. I’ve also heard there are picks out there with a good price that doesn’t go over what I’m comfortable spending.
